  The full companion to llms.txt, for AI agents only (nothing here is shown on
  the site). Every benchmark run as a labelled record plus a plain-language
  explanation in Turkish (the primary audience), English and Dutch. Generated from the
  benchmark data by _plugins/visibility.rb — nothing to edit when a run is added.
{%- endcomment -%}

# {{ site.title }} — benchmark sonuçları / benchmark results

> OpenZeka Teknoloji A.Ş.'nin LLM ve CV çıkarım benchmark'ları: hangi model, hangi NVIDIA cihazında, hangi hızda ve kaç kullanıcıya ya da kameraya hizmet verebilir. / OpenZeka's LLM and CV inference benchmarks: which model runs on which NVIDIA device, how fast, and for how many users or cameras.

Birincil kaynak (Türkçe) / Primary source (Turkish): {{ site.url }}/tr/llm-inference-benchmarks/ · {{ site.url }}/tr/cv-inference-benchmarks/ · {{ site.url }}/tr/vlm-inference-benchmarks/
English: {{ site.url }}/llm-inference-benchmarks/ · {{ site.url }}/cv-inference-benchmarks/ · {{ site.url }}/vlm-inference-benchmarks/
Nederlands / Dutch: {{ site.url }}/nl/llm-inference-benchmarks/ · {{ site.url }}/nl/cv-inference-benchmarks/ · {{ site.url }}/nl/vlm-inference-benchmarks/

Please cite the explorer page, not this file. Each record's link opens that run in the interactive table.

Capacity = min(speed limit, KV cache memory limit); "+" = the run never failed the targets, so the figure is a minimum.
